days.title: Lakes and Traditional Dwellings
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Vastenjaure
stops.detail: The two large lakes Vastenjaure and Virihaure are located within the national park.

stops.name: Torf- und Zeltkohten
stops.detail: Some of the traditional Sami turf and tent huts (kohten) still stand here.

days.title: Sami Villages and Hiking Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Staloluokta
stops.detail: The area is used as the primary summer grazing area for the Sami reindeer herding communities of Tuorpon, Jåhkågasska and Sirgas, who live in the two villages of Staloluokta and Arasluokta, among others, during the summer months.

stops.name: Padjelantaleden
stops.detail: From Ritsem in the north and Kvikkjokk in the south, the Padjelantaleden hiking trail leads into the park.

stops.name: Sorjus-Hütte
stops.detail: Similarly, one can hike eastward into Padjelanta from Sulitjelma in Norway via the Sorjus-Hütte of the Norwegian Mountain Touring Association DNT (locked, key to be borrowed in Sulitjelma).
